goal: Keep valid relative-locktime transactions and their descendants in the mempool during chain reorgs
Prevent false evictions when a reorg lowers the chain tip or median time past
agreement: Strong support with prior concerns on mixed inputs and time locks resolved
Verified bug reproduction on master and fix on branch (Bortlesboat, DevaanshPathak)
Approved after recalculation approach was adopted and tests consolidated (ismaelsadeeq)
Code review and test verification approval (tumutech)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it fixes false eviction of valid transaction families from the mempool during reorgs
Keeps unconfirmed dependency chains intact across reorgs without risking consensus divergence
